objective: Adapt ACL26_ADI into an AutoOpt-managed Arabic Dialect Identification project with a clean ADI-only optimization loop.
goal: Freeze the first serious acoustic-only ADI baseline on ECOschool, evaluate it on a frozen formal dev suite, and treat the Local gold evaluation set as the final success gate.

success_metrics.name: adaptation_readiness
success_metrics.description: Whether ACL26_ADI has been adapted into a runnable AutoOpt project.

success_metrics.name: formal_dev_accuracy
success_metrics.description: Accuracy on the frozen formal dev suite for the first serious ECO acoustic-only baseline.

success_metrics.name: formal_dev_macro_f1
success_metrics.description: Macro F1 on the frozen formal dev suite.

success_metrics.name: local_gold_macro_f1
success_metrics.description: Macro F1 on the Local gold evaluation suite, which acts as the final gate.

constraints: Focus on ADI only, not ASR correction.
Treat ACL/ as the source of truth unless a contradiction is resolved explicitly.
Do not mutate ACL26_ADI blindly; prefer wrappers and mirrored configs first.
Use conda env AutoOpt for project execution.
Do not stage large training data with rsync/scp; prefer rclone -> TOS -> /data for A100 hosts.
Local gold is evaluation-only and must never be used for training.
ADI5 upstream pools remain blocked for training until exact overlap removal is implemented.
